_meta.naming_convention: H/V prefix (horizontal/vertical orientation) + FAMILY code + variant suffix

variant_suffixes.numeric: pole count or amperage rating (e.g. Q9=9A, Q21=21A, Q25=25A)

AN.description: Annunciator / alarm indicator. Variants: B=buzzer, S=sounder, Z=beacon

BE.description: Rotating/flashing beacon. Variants: RFL=rotating flash, RRT=rotating

CB.description: Moulded case circuit breaker (MCCB). CB1 = single type, CB11 = with accessories. Q# suffix = ampere frame (Q9=9A … Q146=146A). TH=thermal, THI=thermal inverse trip. CB2 = smaller frame.
CB.notes: CB2 family (V only) is a compact/DIN-rail MCB variant

CR.description: Control relay. CR1 = standard relay coil+contacts. CR21/22/23 = relay contact symbols (NO/NC/changeover). Variant suffixes indicate specific models: HSP=high-speed, SSD=solid-state delay, K33/F34=specific catalogue models, OOD=off-delay, CNE/CNM/CNN=contact arrangements.
CR.safety_note: CR1 variants with SSD or HSP suffix may represent safety relay coils — cross-check with drawing tag (KF prefix) and forced-guided contact notation. Dedicated safety relay symbols are not present; safety relays will use CR1 with safety-specific tag.
CR.notes: CR21/22/23 = relay contact only (no coil) — used as auxiliary contact symbols on drawings

DS.description: Isolator / disconnect switch. DS11 = 3-pole, DS21 = 2-pole. Q# suffix = ampere rating.

FL.description: HRC fuse link (cartridge). FL11/FL12 = type 1/2 fuseholder formats.

FS.description: Fuse switch disconnector. FS11/FS12 = single/double break. S20 suffix = 20A rated.

FT.description: Foot-operated switch. FT11/FT12 = NO/NC variants. L suffix = with guard/latch.
FT.safety_note: Foot switches are enabling devices under ISO 13849. Check PLr requirement; unguarded foot switch cannot be sole safety measure.

FU.description: Fuse (general). FU1/FU2 = type variants. FS suffix = fuseholder with switch.

LS.description: Limit switch / position switch. LS11=NO, LS12=NC. C suffix = cam-operated. S13/S16/S84/S87 suffix = specific actuator/roller head variants.
LS.safety_note: Limit switches used as guard interlocks must meet ISO 14119 requirements. Check whether positive-opening mechanism (direct-opening action) is specified — standard LS symbols do not distinguish this; must be noted in BOM or title block.

LT.description: Pilot indicator light. Colour suffix: A=amber, B=blue, C=clear, G=green, R=red, W=white, Y=yellow. H13/H25 = high-intensity LED.

MO.description: Electric motor. MO12/13/14 = 2/3/4-pole variants. M9/M11 = terminal count variants (9 or 11 terminals — likely includes brake/thermistor terminals).
MO.notes: M11 variant likely represents motor with integral brake and thermistor — relevant to STO/SBC safety functions

MS.description: Motor starter / contactor. MS1 = direct-on-line starter. MS21P/MS22P = 1-phase variants (single/double-throw).
MS.safety_note: Safety-rated contactors (e.g. force-guided / positively guided) use the same symbol. Distinguish by manufacturer model in title block. Per IEC 62061 / ISO 13849, safety contactor must be force-guided and monitored.

OL.description: Thermal overload relay. OL1 = standard, OL2 = compact variant.

PB.description: Push button station. PB11=NO, PB12=NC. See variant map below.
PB.safety_note: MTL suffix = turn-to-release (IEC 60947-5-5 compliant e-stop). M suffix = mushroom head only (may or may not be IEC e-stop rated — check manufacturer model). E-stop push buttons must be tagged SF per AS4024.1601.

PC.description: Panel / equipment connector. PC11/PC12 = type variants. L suffix = locking.

PE.description: PE / earth terminal block. B16 = 16mm² busbar. PE2/PE3/PE4 = 2/3/4-wire configurations. R suffix = reversed orientation.
PE.safety_note: PE terminal continuity is a safety requirement under AS/NZS 3000 and AS4024. Must be documented in panel schedule.

PS.description: DC power supply / SMPS. PS11/PS12 = single/dual output variants.

PW.description: Power wiring symbol / incoming supply. G4 = 4-group. 1PH / 3PH = single / three-phase.

PX.description: Variable frequency drive (VFD) / inverter. PX11 = standard drive frame, PX12 = larger frame. Drive-type suffixes: I/IN3=inverter output, M/M3=motor side, C=converter/rectifier, U=universal, TS=terminal strip view. 3/3R suffix = 3-phase / 3-phase reversed.
PX.safety_note: STO (Safe Torque Off) and other safety functions (SS1, SS2, SOS, SLS) per IEC 61800-5-2 must be explicitly shown as separate signal connections. The PX symbol represents the drive body only — STO wiring must be shown connecting to the safety controller. Verify STO category meets PLr requirement.

SS.description: Selector / rotary switch. SS11 = 2-position, SS12 = 3-position, SS21/SS22 = 2-row variants. Numeric suffix = contact count. L=left-hold, R=right-hold, NL=no-latch, B=boot-guard, F=flush. S## = specific catalogue models.
SS.safety_note: Key-operated selector switches (must check title block for 'key' designation) are commonly used as mode selectors in safety circuits. Position must be monitored if used to select a safety mode (AS4024.1503).

SV.description: Solenoid valve. Y1=2/2 way, Y1A=2/2 spring return, Y3=3/2 way, Y4=4/2 way.
SV.safety_note: Pneumatic/hydraulic solenoid valves in safety functions must be spring-return (de-energise to safe state) per AS4024.1502/1503. Y1A is spring-return. Check valve failure mode for category assessment.

SW.description: General-purpose switch (toggle / rocker). SW11/SW12 = NO/NC variants. S77 = specific model.

T.description: Terminal block. T0002=standard feed-through, T0W02=with wire marker, T0_02=2-wire, T0_LGENERIC=generic label terminal, T1002=test-point terminal.

TC.description: Terminal cover / end-stop for terminal rail.

TD.description: Timer relay. TD1=1-function, TD21/TD22=dual-function. Mode: F=on-delay, N=off-delay, DOO=door-open off-delay.

TS.description: Terminal strip / marshalling block. TS11/TS12 = single/double row. S59C = 59-way with cover.

XF.description: Transformer. XF1=control transformer, CT=current transformer, CTR=CT reversed, P3=3-phase power transformer.

gaps: No dedicated safety relay symbol (Pilz PNOZsigma, SICK Flexi, etc.) — uses CR1 with safety tag
No dedicated safety PLC symbol — not present in library
No light curtain / AOPD symbol (IEC 61496) — not present in library
No AS4024.1602 two-hand control symbol — not present in library
